appName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store

appDescription.message: Chrome extension that locally tunes the readability, audio, and continuity of the page you are viewing.

defaultTitle.description: Hover tooltip on the toolbar icon

headerTagline.message: Amplify, declutter, sustain — from one panel
headerTagline.description: Tagline shown beneath the popup header

volumeBoosterMasterDesc.message: Amplify and shape tab audio. Settings auto-apply on tab switch.

volumeSubDesc.message: Set the player volume to 100% and adjust here for the best result.

volumeAntiClipDesc.message: Tame sudden shouts and effect peaks to prevent clipping when boosting.

volumeNormalizeDesc.message: Measure the average loudness of each video or stream and equalize it via auto-gain.

volumeNightModeDesc.message: Gently compress loud voices and explosions so quiet game audio is not buried.

videoGammaMasterDescPost.message: elements on the page. Brightens dark videos and softens overly bright ones.

videoGammaSubDesc.message: 1.0 means no correction. Below 1.0 lifts shadows (brighter); above 1.0 boosts contrast (darker).

videoFillMasterDesc.message: Removes letterbox/pillarbox black bars on ultrawide screens by zooming or stretching the video to fill the screen.

videoFillTargetDesc.message: Pick your screen's aspect ratio or resolution; each video's shape is auto-detected to remove black bars.

loupeMasterDesc.message: Magnify the current view with a circular lens. Best used after pausing videos. Left-click to turn off.

rtxEnhancerMasterDesc.message: Inject a hint element on pages containing <video> so GPU drivers like NVIDIA RTX Super Resolution can detect the video and apply automatic enhancement (requires GPU-side activation, e.g., in NVIDIA Control Panel).

loupeSizeDesc.message: Adjust the lens diameter between 150 and 1000 px.

loupeErrorUnsupportedPage.message: ⚠ Loupe is not available on this page

amazonDeliveryMasterDescPre.message: Show a per-month total on the

amazonRankingJumpMasterDesc.message: Show a "Go to this product's ranking" button at the top of product pages.
amazonRankingJumpMasterDesc.description: Master toggle description for the Amazon jump-to-ranking button

amazonMerchantInfoMasterDesc.message: Show a seller / shipper badge at the top of product pages (Amazon-fulfilled = green / marketplace = orange warning).
amazonMerchantInfoMasterDesc.description: Master toggle description for the Amazon seller / shipper badge

keepAliveMasterDesc.message: Reset idle detection across all http(s) tabs by dispatching synthetic events.

keepAliveHttpPingLabel.message: Also send a lightweight server ping

keepAliveHttpPingDesc.message: HEAD/GET only against the top frame of each tab. Disable behind auth proxies.

searchFixerMasterDesc.message: Manage 30 sub-features at once: Shorts removal, search noise filtering, watch-page cleanup, comment hiding, live-chat hiding, subscriptions enhancements, and more.

instagramCleanerMasterDesc.message: Hide redundant UI such as Reels, Explore, and Stories in one toggle.

tiktokCleanerMasterDesc.message: Hide redundant UI such as the comment panel and suggested-account section in one toggle.

cleanerHint.message: Active only while the master toggle (cleaner) is on. Pick the individual sub-features you want.

pickerActivateJp.message: Pick a color from the screen

pickerNoteIdle.message: Press the button to pick any color on screen (Esc cancels).

feat_sf_playlist_desc.message: Remove playlist entries (playlist?list= links / "N videos" badges).

feat_sf_shortsBtn_desc.message: Remove standalone Shorts cards mixed into video grids (vertical-video items whose thumbnail URL is /shorts/).

feat_sf_removeShortsShelf_desc.message: Physically remove the Home Shorts shelf (ytd-rich-shelf-renderer[is-shorts]) and the search-result Shorts horizontal shelf (ytd-reel-shelf-renderer).

feat_sf_live_desc.message: Remove videos with LIVE / Premiere / Station thumbnail badges. "Station" = YouTube auto-generated infinite BGM streams.

feat_sf_membersOnly_desc.message: Remove videos with the "Members only" thumbnail badge that require channel membership to watch.

feat_sf_watched_desc.message: Remove videos that show a resume-playback overlay (already watched).

feat_sf_removeTopicsSection_desc.message: Remove the "More topics" genre recommendation section (ytd-rich-section-renderer) at the bottom of Home (feed pages only).

feat_sf_removeBreakingNewsSection_desc.message: Remove the breaking-news article section (ytd-rich-section-renderer) on Home (feed pages only).

feat_sf_shelf_desc.message: Remove video group sections (ytd-shelf-renderer) such as "Trending" or "News".

feat_sf_cardList_desc.message: Remove the related-topics horizontal card list (ytd-horizontal-card-list-renderer, second and later).

feat_sf_course_desc.message: Remove learning-content cards with the "Course" badge (.yt-lockup-view-model--wrapper).

feat_sf_channel_desc.message: Remove the "This channel" intro cards (ytd-channel-renderer) injected into search results.

feat_sf_reel_desc.message: Remove the horizontal Shorts shelf (grid-shelf-view-model). The Home Shorts shelf is removed by removeShortsShelf in "Video filter"; the left sidebar entry by removeShortsSidebar in "Menu / UI".

feat_sf_secondary_desc.message: Remove the "Related search keywords" suggestion block at the bottom (ytd-secondary-search-container-renderer).

feat_sf_verified_desc.message: Remove videos from channels with a Verified badge (official accounts, news). Feed-page support coming.

feat_sf_artist_desc.message: Remove videos with an Official Artist Channel badge (e.g. official MVs). Feed-page support coming.

feat_sf_chapter_desc.message: Remove videos that expose expandable chapter info (expandable-metadata-renderer).

feat_sf_demoteUnmatched_desc.message: Half-fade and grayscale videos whose title/description does not contain the search keyword (restored on hover).

feat_sf_highlightThumb_desc.message: Add an akane-red outline and drop shadow around each thumbnail for better scanability (works in dark and light themes).

feat_sf_hideComments_desc.message: Hide the entire comment section (count, sort, input, threads) on the watch page. Live-stream chat is unaffected.

feat_sf_hideLiveChat_desc.message: Collapse the live-chat panel on archived live streams using YouTube's own collapse action. Regular videos are unaffected.

feat_sf_redirectShortsUrl_desc.message: Force a /shorts/<ID> vertical-video page to the regular /watch?v=<ID> player.

feat_sf_searchGrid_desc.message: Convert search results from a single-column list to a multi-column grid (column count follows the grid setting; Auto matches the Home column count).

feat_sf_removeShortsChip_desc.message: Remove only the "Shorts" chip from the filter row ("All / Videos / Shorts / Playlists …") at the top of the search page.

feat_sf_removeShortsSidebar_desc.message: Remove the "Shorts" entry from the left sidebar (both expanded and collapsed forms).

feat_sf_subsLeftnavInjectAll_label.message: Show all subscriptions in the left menu

feat_sf_subsLeftnavInjectAll_desc.message: Inject all subscriptions hidden by YouTube's display cap into the left sidebar Subscriptions section (fetched same-origin from /feed/channels, cached 24h).

feat_sf_subsAllShortcut_desc.message: Add a one-click entry to /feed/channels at the top of the left sidebar Subscriptions section, styled like a native menu item.

feat_sf_subsChannelsGrid_label.message: Subscriptions page as grid (with search & sort)

feat_sf_subsChannelsGrid_desc.message: Reshape /feed/channels into a responsive grid like a video feed, with a search box and sort toggle (name / subscribers / subscription order). Each card lazy-fetches the latest video thumbnail when entering the viewport (cached 24h).

feat_sf_homeGrid_desc.message: Lay out the Home and subscription feeds as a gap-free grid (packs videos across shelves like Shorts). Also aligns when columns are set to Auto (with 4/5/6 columns it always grids, even with this toggle off).

feat_ig_reels_desc.message: Hide the Reels entry in the sidebar/navigation and force-redirect /reels/ URLs to Home.

feat_ig_explore_desc.message: Hide the Explore entry in the sidebar/navigation and force-redirect /explore/ URLs to Home.

feat_ig_stories_desc.message: Hide the Stories tray (24h disappearing short videos) at the top of the Home feed via CSS.

feat_ig_storiesAll_desc.message: Redirect any /stories/ visit to Home (prevents accidental clicks on shared links).

feat_ig_threads_desc.message: Hide the banner, sidebar entry, and footer link that promote the Threads app.

feat_ig_vanity_desc.message: Detect numeric buttons (commas, k, M, etc.) inside <article> and hide them to reduce comparison fatigue.

feat_ig_blockVideos_desc.message: Mark <video> elements inside feed <article>s and replace them with a thumbnail via CSS to prevent autoplay.

feat_ig_comments_desc.message: Hide the comment list, input form, and "View N comments" link via CSS.

feat_ig_notes_desc.message: Hide the Notes row (short status messages over profile photos) at the top of the DM screen.

feat_ig_msgCounters_desc.message: Hide the unread DM count badge (red circle with a number) on the navigation to ease notification pressure.

feat_ig_imageDownload_desc.message: Overlay a download button on the top-left of post photos (feed / profile grid / post detail) on hover. Picks the largest variant from srcset.

feat_tt_hideComments_desc.message: Hide the comment panel (the comment list shown alongside the player), the comment icon button, and the comment count via CSS.

feat_tt_hideSuggested_desc.message: Hide the "Suggested accounts" section injected into For You / Following feeds and profiles via CSS.

feat_tt_imageDownload_desc.message: Overlay a download button on the top-left of photo posts and video thumbnails on hover.
